title: Point Hari Vulkan hybrid wiki to canonical Minecraft project
head: 10d6680cce9168bdfab34b758448e796b0d8a07b
root_cause: The hourly publisher mirrors versioned main/wikis exactly; direct edits to the .wiki.git page are overwritten. PR30 changes only the versioned source page so the existing publisher can retain canonical routing.
scope_decision: Standing request limits publication to feature branches/draft PRs and says no merge unless separately authorized. Review and local byte/URL/scope tests pass; do not infer merge authorization from general continuation. Keep draft and do not repeatedly fight generated wiki bytes.
